newsitem.title: JAPAN: Recent currency moves substantial - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Recent currency moves substantial - BOJ.

text.p: Recent currency moves have been substantial, and therefore the Bank of Japan (BOJ) will remain vigilant about currency movements, Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a news conference on Wednesday.
He said exchange rates should reflect economic fundamentals and it is appropriate for exchange rates to stabilise.

"I would like to refrain from making any comments on specific currency levels... However, recent currency moves have been substantial and we will keep a close watch (on the currency markets)," he said.
Matsushita said that the Bank of Japan's basic monetary policy is to act quickly while keeping a close watch on prices of goods and assets.
He said the central bank has learned from past experiences that it is not proper to put emphasis on exchange rates and external imbalances when it makes monetary policy decisions.
